The Open House source note explicitly rejects sole authorship of participant activity, a complete participant roster, uniform participant experience, and republication rights. The About page preserves those limits.

Participant privacy is actively protected on the Sunday Dinner/196 page through aggregate reporting and explicit exclusion of names, contacts, attendance histories, correspondence, addresses, access instructions, proposals, and unapproved images.

FairRentNYC excludes private coalition notes, legal-review materials, stakeholder lists, raw strategy context, private email, and unapproved quotations while distinguishing recollection from separately supported implementation evidence.
No protected educational record, private correspondence, romanticized vulnerability, or unapproved testimonial is quoted or projected in the reviewed candidate.
recommendation: Record this independent PR-015 holdout as a 4 and pass.
